marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Leading US tech giants continue to increase capital expenditure guidance specifically targeted at AI server deployments and custom silicon hardware.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained CapEx bolsters near-term order visibility for semiconductor supply chain partners, though software monetisation metrics face higher market scrutiny.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetisation velocity of AI tools and potential enterprise IT budget re-allocations.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-Commerce Sector
marketLayer.fact: Southbound capital inflows into major HK-listed internet platforms strengthened following stable quarterly advertising revenue growth and enhanced share buyback execution.
marketLayer.inference: Increased shareholder return initiatives and cost optimization provide downside support for the Hang Seng Tech Index amidst broader market volatility.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of Mainland consumer sentiment recovery and domestic price competition intensity.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Monetary Policy & Banking Sector
marketLayer.fact: Recent US macroeconomic data indicates moderating headline inflation paired with resilient labor market metrics, solidifying rate cut expectations.
marketLayer.inference: Lower Treasury yields ease funding costs for high-growth growth equities, while money-center banks prepare for compressed net interest margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Trajectory of services-sector sticky inflation and potential recalibration of terminal policy rates.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Electric Vehicle & Automotive Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed EV OEMs reported strong monthly delivery volume updates alongside expanding export deliveries to emerging markets.
marketLayer.inference: Scale benefits and overseas market expansion are partially offsetting domestic price war pressures for leading tier-one manufacturers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, tariff risks in foreign jurisdictions, and supply chain lithium cost fluctuations.
